contract.name: AIDecisionAudit
contract.purpose: Immutable AI decision audit with supersede pattern

capabilities.recordDecision: Anchor AI decision as (inputHash, reasoningHash, outputHash, confidence)
capabilities.supersedeDecision: Mark decision corrected - original preserved on-chain forever
capabilities.verifyDecision: Prove claimed decision matches on-chain record

mapsTo: Stop Rogue AI Act - real-time monitoring + auditable decisions
AI Kill Switch Act - decision-level revocation via supersede
counterTo: Model concealing mistakes (supersede is transparent, original stays)
Model inventing missing data (reasoningHash forces commit to rationale)
Model telling successor to hide misalignment (immutable chain of decisions)
